For such a huge thing as research paper, I think the deadline for research paper should not change back and forth. Besides, even if it was an ENG101 course element, we also prepared discussion presentations for ENG102. I know Sibel Hoca did it with good intentions so that we could enrich our knowledge about the course topic from different perspectives, however, when we already had so little time due to the essay task, proceeding with discussion presentations for weeks was such a loss of time in my opinion where we could have used it to work on our research papers or just proceeded with TedTalk discussions. The course topic (neoliberalism) was something everybody could relate to somehow, but I don't think it complements interests of all students. So maybe for following semesters, choosing a topic which everybody can relate to something that they are interested in in much convenient way compared to neoliberalism can make students much more eager to make effort for the course.
